newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, Calif., cities sue to block airport.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, Calif., cities sue to block airport.

text.p: Eight Orange County, Calif., cities have filed a lawsuit to halt plans to convert El Toro Marine Corps Air Station into a major commercial airport, according to a published report Friday.

The lawsuit, filed in Orange County Superior Court, claimed that the environmental impact report for the proposed commercial passenger and cargo airport had downplayed the effect of the project's noise, traffic and pollution on the area, the Los Angeles Times reported.
The lawsuit was filed by Irvine, Lake Forest, Mission Viejo, Laguna Hills, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Beach, Dana Point and San Juan Capistrano.
In December, Orange County Board of Supervisors voted to turn the base into a commercial airport. El Toro is scheduled to be converted to civilian usage by 1999.

A recent study of future uses of El Toro concluded that converting the base into an international airport would pump nearly $10 billion a year into the area's economy. The airport could cost up to $1.6 billion to build, according to some estimates.
